about_the_game:
Part 1: The Hook

This is not just a coin pusher. This is a spectacular duel between you and a divine guardian.

Cosmic Cast: The Guardian Pusher is a unique single-player coin pusher that blends oriental fantasy aesthetics with skill-based gameplay and roguelite-style permanent progression. Here, every single coin you cast is a challenge against the cosmos. Dare you face the formidable statue guarding the treasury and win its ultimate favor?

Part 2: Key Features

  • A One-of-a-Kind Oriental Fantasy Experience
    Step into an exquisite pagoda crafted by ancient masters, filled with mystical mechanisms. Amidst the dim glow of braziers and curling incense smoke, challenge the imposing Asura statue and immerse yourself in a coin-pushing atmosphere like never before.

  • The "Cosmic Cast": Where Skill Meets Chance
    The core gameplay begins with your cast. You'll need to navigate through a treacherous board of pins (Pachinko-style), time your shots to bypass moving Bagua mechanisms, and precisely hit triggers to activate the slot machine. Every cast is a thrilling test of both skill and luck.

  • Endless Rewards & The Ultimate "Coin Shower" Thrill
    The frequently triggered slot machine is the source of all great rewards! Unleash glorious "Jade Showers" and drop precious "Dragon Pearls" onto the platform. Use the unique abilities of Jades to clear the board, and finally, push the Dragon Pearl off the edge to unlock the "Dragon's Trial" - your path to the ultimate jackpot!

  • Permanent Progression in the Artificer's Treasury
    The game doesn't end with pushing coins. Collect "Tickets" to unlock dozens of permanent upgrades in the Treasury. Increase your coin capacity, accelerate resource regeneration, and even unlock game-changing "Secret Treasures" like "Start the game with a coin shower" or "Double the rewards of your first daily spin." Every session empowers you for the next challenge.

  • Become a Master Collector
    Gather a vast collection of rare artifacts scattered within the treasury—from Jade Ruyi to Bronze Ding. Your ultimate goal is to find the lost golden statues of the Twelve Zodiacs, unlocking the game's final secrets and supreme honors.

Part 3: The Call to Action

Are you ready? Adjust your aim, seize the fleeting opportunity, and make your "Cosmic Cast" towards the pagoda overflowing with riches. Endless treasures await a challenger with true wisdom and courage.

Add Cosmic Cast: The Guardian Pusher to your wishlist now and prepare to embark on this unique oriental fantasy treasure hunt!
